objective: Consolidate missing approved Nov 19 UI and reader updates into the exact Genesis 2.0 preview native ancestor without propagating unverified native changes or activating locked rewards. Exact source change includes avatar rank, permanent Notes, KL dictionary, Bible rubric and secure admin registration inbox, plus lazy read-only approved ten-feature and full BP/QMP/two-track encyclopedias. Restore previously approved Connect compact bubbles, tap timestamp, read cursor-safe group Seen and latest-on-keyboard behavior across personal and all scope rooms. Stage approved 915-day offline Proverbs read-only Show Faith card after existing first-view Wall ad, gated to Genesis preview; no Season 2 reward grants. Restore all eight reviewed LIFE page language hydration and account-specific offline selection from staging without querying raw user profile data on each page.

chosenApproach: Carefully port only stage-reviewed and non-mutating source hunks; avoid copying entire divergent branch. Account-scoped rank RPC read-only, preserve existing 40 badge atlas. Fail-close preview-only content; no new backend writes or entitlement.
